mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing quinidine plasma concentrations and QT prolongation risk; turmeric also has mild antiplatelet effects that may potentiate bleeding.
action: Monitor ECG for QT prolongation and quinidine levels; consider adjusting quinidine dose if turmeric use is concurrent; counsel patient to maintain consistent turmeric intake to avoid fluctuations.
